trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself. There is no shortcut: the road runs through the full story, the 100% completion checklist, every activity and every collectible in this guide. Expect a long hunt — launch-era estimates put the Platinum at roughly 100 to 200 hours, with the story alone taking around 50.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission of the game, so you cannot miss it — just play through the opening until the mission-complete screen appears. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter anyway: GTA VI has no mission replay, so a save is your only way back.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through every main mission of Chapter 1 until the chapter closes. Before you leave Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house — it is the one interaction in the game that may be missable (see Positive Mental Attitude). After the meditation, the chapter trophy is simply a matter of finishing the story missions in order.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission of Chapter 2. Chapter 2 opens up both playable characters, so most of the list starts here: stranger missions, pawn shops and the wider map. Do the stranger chains as they appear — several are tied to story progress and are easier to finish while you are in the chapter than after it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission of Chapter 3. This is where the bigger robbery systems open: bank jobs begin here, jewelry stores open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, and Yago's street-racing strand appears — one of its races is time-sensitive (it carries an hourglass icon), so run Race Against Yago the moment it shows up. Bank jobs and jewelry robberies also feed the 100% checklist, so work them as you go.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission of Chapter 4. Bank vaults open in this chapter — they hand you a 4-star Wanted level, so plan an escape route before you crack one. You are one step from the finale now: keep a manual save before the final mission, because there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Play the final story mission to the credits. Make a manual save right before you start it — once it is done, the story is over, the 100% checklist appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, and there is no way to replay the mission. Everything you did during the story already counts toward that checklist, so free roam after the credits is where the Platinum hunt continues.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as part of the main story, so follow the mission markers — pink icons with black letters are main missions. No special preparation is needed; it pops on the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a main-story heist, so it comes to you as the story progresses — keep following the pink mission icons. Bring your best weapons and armour into it: heists are the longest firefights in the story, and dying mid-mission only restarts the checkpoint.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. Like every named story mission in this list, it unlocks in story order and pops when the mission ends. If you are hunting the Platinum, use the mission as a reminder to keep your manual chapter saves fresh — the game never lets you replay a finished mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. It is a main-story mission, so it arrives in story order — follow the pink mission markers. The trophy pops on completion; nothing extra is required, and it counts toward your story progress on the road to the final mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown. It plays out at Vice City International Airport, so expect a big set-piece with vehicles and heavy gunfire. It is a story mission, so it arrives in order — just follow the pink markers and finish it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a late-story operation, so come in stocked: full armour, your best rifles and a fast getaway vehicle parked nearby. The trophy pops the moment the mission completes.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Finish the in-game 100% checklist: 35 requirements in three groups — Story and tasks (12), Exploration and activities (20) and Discovery (3). The checklist only appears after the credits, under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, but everything you did during the story already counts. It is lenient: most items need only part of a set (15 of 18 card sets, 200 of 277 vehicles, 70 of 80 challenges), and nothing on it is missable — every requirement can still be done in free roam. The full-requirement items are the robberies (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loans), the 42 shooting-range gold medals, 300 stunts and the underwater discoveries. This is the hardest trophy in the game and the last one most hunters earn before the Platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts of any kind: stunt jumps off ramps, flying under bridges, knife flights and base jumps. Stunts are marked on the map once you find them, and the game tracks each one. Note that 100% completion wants 300 of the 397 stunts, so keep going past 250 — every stunt you land now is one less later. Fast bikes and planes make the jump and flight stunts far easier than cars do.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type in the game at least once — nine in total, from races and fishing to the shooting range, drone races and the arcade. Open the Activities list in the game to see which types you have tried and which are still blank, then tick them off one by one. You only need to try each one, not win or finish it, so this is one of the quickest trophies on the list.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each range has several weapon challenges with score and time targets for gold — use the weapon the challenge hands you, aim for headshots to build the multiplier, and reload during the lulls, not mid-wave. This is one of the few trophies that 100% completion also demands in full, so there is no skipping a hard one: practice the weakest weapon first while your aim is fresh.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of its locations around Leonida. The races are marked once you find the Top Fun vans — fly the drone through the rings as fast as you can and learn each course's tight corners, since the racing line matters more than top speed. The separate drone time trials (42 of them) belong to the 100% checklist, so the flying practice here pays off twice.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — street races, off-road, boat and air races all count, as long as each one is a different event. The blue race icons on the map are the unique races; 100% completion wants 30 of the 40 won, so keep racing past 20. Upgrade your vehicle for the class you are racing, learn the braking points, and use slipstream on the straights to pass the pack.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at the fishing spots around Leonida and take his challenge: the trick is reeling steadily — reel when the fish runs against you and ease off when the line strains, or it snaps. Fishing with Cal also counts as an optional task toward 100%, so do it whenever you pass a fishing spot.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game at any arcade cabinet in Leonida. Walk up to a cabinet, start a game and play it through to its end — any cabinet and any game counts. Arcades are scattered through Vice City's malls and bars; the trophy pops when the game-over or completion screen shows.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Stranger missions appear as question-mark icons — start Andy's chain as soon as it unlocks and follow it through, since stranger strands are tied to story progress. The final mission is the last step; finish it and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Start the chain when its question-mark icon first appears and keep returning to it between story missions — stranger strands can stall if you leave them until after the story. The trophy pops when Kenton's last mission completes.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Billy's chain is one of the five character strands behind the stranger trophies — pick it up when it appears and see it through before the story moves too far on. The final mission closes the strand and the trophy with it.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Stranger missions show as question-mark icons; each strand is several missions long. Start every strand the moment it unlocks — several are tied to story progress, and at least one race in Yago's strand (Race Against Yago, Chapter 3) is time-sensitive and carries an hourglass icon, so run it the day it appears. The five character finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are five of the eight; find three more strands around the map to finish the set.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Randy also buys fenced vehicles — sports cars in perfect condition pay him $35,000 or more, which feeds the $200,000 vehicle-fencing requirement of the 100% checklist. Do his strand early and keep selling him cars as you go.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Tyrone's labs count as optional tasks toward 100%, so his missions do double duty. Start the strand when it appears and finish it before the story moves on — stranger chains are safest done in the chapter they unlock in.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total. THIS IS THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: the first meditation is Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth. Go there in the morning, follow her out to the balcony and take the optional meditation — it disappears once Chapter 1 ends, and it is unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it to be safe and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. The other spots are marked meditation locations around the map; sit at each one until the session completes.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting quests send you after specific animals — track the target, take the shot cleanly and bring it back. Studying animals through binoculars also feeds the 100% checklist (100 of 255 studied), so scan everything you see while you hunt. Use a scoped rifle and approach downwind; spooked animals bolt and waste the trip.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — 480 in total across 18 sets — and each set needs every card in it. The 100% checklist wants 15 of the 18 sets, so this trophy is just the start: collect in an area fully before moving on, and use the in-game card tracker to see which sets are one or two cards short.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations — landmarks, sculptures and curiosities across Leonida. Open WAiNK near a point of interest and scan it; the app marks what counts. The 100% checklist wants exactly these 100 locations, so this trophy and that checklist item finish together. Scan as you travel rather than backtracking: every new district you enter has several WAiNK spots.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small feats the game tracks everywhere — stunts, kills, driving feats, collectibles milestones — and they tick over naturally as you play. The 100% checklist wants 70 of the 80, so keep pushing past 50: open the Challenges list, pick the nearly-done ones first, and clear them in batches between missions.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. The easiest way: cause chaos in a quiet area until the fourth star appears, then break line of sight and hide — an alley, a parking garage or a fast car on the highway all work. Stay with your partner through the escape; the trophy pops when the wanted stars clear while you are together.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your Wanted level. Pick three shops close together, hit the register in each, and keep moving — do not stop to fight the police, and do not let the wanted stars clear between robberies. A fast car parked outside the third shop is your exit. If the stars clear, the chain breaks and you start over.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — scan them with the WAiNK app as you find them. Any vehicle you have not logged before counts: cars, bikes, boats, planes and more. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so keep scanning everything you drive past. Rare vehicles spawn in specific districts, so tour the whole map rather than circling one city.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a fight with a crowd — a gang shootout or a police ambush — and chain headshots while time slows. Pick a spot with cover and five or more enemies in view before you trigger it, so you are not hunting for the last target as the meter drains.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport: get a plane and take off without a flight plan. Steal any parked plane on the VCIA apron, taxi to a runway and get airborne — the trophy pops when you leave the ground. Expect police attention on the runway, so pick a quiet moment and a fast plane.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Drive a Rhino tank. Tanks turn up around military sites and during high-heat police responses — climb into one and drive it. You only need to be behind the controls, so once you are in, the trophy pops. If the army is shooting at you, drive away first and enjoy the ride after.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Jewelry stores open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3. Go in quiet: move slowly, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. A suppressed weapon and patience beat speed here — one spotted guard ends the attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. Bank vaults open in Chapter 4, and every vault robbery hands you a 4-star Wanted level, so plan the escape before you crack the vault: a fast car or bike parked outside, and a route out of the police search area. Five vaults, five clean getaways — the trophy pops after the fifth escape.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — wait for one on a quiet stretch, block it or blast the rear doors, grab the cash and get clear before the police box you in. A sticky bomb on the doors and a fast car for the getaway is the classic approach, and the name is the hint.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every part of Leonida — Vice City, the beaches, the swamps, the keys and the countryside. The trophy pops once the map is fully revealed, so drive, fly and sail into every corner: the map fills in as you travel, and the far islands and backroads are the parts most players leave blank. Pair this with WAiNK scans and vehicle discovery and the whole map pays off three times over.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Gang operations are the yellow map icons — 39 in total — and each one belongs to a gang. Hit one operation per gang, looting the key valuables at each site (hover the icon to see what is left). The 100% checklist wants all 39 cleared, so this trophy is the first step of a much longer robbery list.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. The description points to Ocean Beach: find a bar with a sea view along Ocean Drive, order a cocktail and enjoy the view. Community reports had not pinned down a trigger when this guide was written — try the beachfront bars at sunset and check back here for updates.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. The description points to a vehicle showroom: drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the other side, in the style of the classic showroom-smash moments. Community reports had not pinned down a trigger when this guide was written — try the big dealerships in Vice City and check back here for updates.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Walk up to a lane, bowl your frames and follow through to the end of the game — the trophy is about finishing the game, not your score. The alley is in Vice City; look for the Kolt & Associates signage.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A story trophy with a deliberately vague description — it unlocks by playing the story with your partner. There is no separate task to hunt: keep playing the main missions and the partner activities, and it pops at its story moment. If it has not popped by the credits, check the partner-activity trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) — the trigger sits somewhere in that partnership.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: This trophy is tied to the Criminal Profile — the record of how you play. PowerPyx and GTABase both report that the 'Irredeemable' rating is permanent, so read your Criminal Profile before going on a rampage: your choices across the game shape it. The trophy pops when your choices reach its trigger; there is no single mission for it, so play naturally and check the profile as you go.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. The description suggests a second attempt at something that failed the first time — a retry that lands. Community reports had not pinned down a trigger when this guide was written; it is most likely tied to a story moment that gives you a second chance. Check back here for updates as players confirm it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. The description reads like a UFO or strange-encounter trophy — the kind of one-off oddity Rockstar hides in the world. Community reports had not pinned down a trigger when this guide was written. If you see something strange in the skies over Leonida, investigate it — and check back here for updates.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch, but the description is a recipe: a melee drive-by that bowls people over — strike targets with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle, bowling-pin style. The bowling alley (see Let's Go Bowling) is the likely stage. Try a drive-by with a bat from a slow car near a group and see if it pops; check back here for updates as players confirm it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from bank jobs and payday loan jobs — one large bank can pay up to $205,000 — so run the bank jobs (22 of them for the 100% checklist) and fence the bills as you go. The total is cumulative across the whole game, and the fencing total also feeds the 100% checklist, so this trophy and that item finish together.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across the shops of Leonida — clothes, weapons, car mods, food, anything with a price tag. The total is cumulative, so it ticks over naturally as you gear up for the story: buy your best weapons, mod your favourite cars and dress both characters well. If you are short at the end, a few high-end car mods close the gap fast.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in Leonida. Garages are bought from the in-game property sites — check the map for for-sale signs and buy each one as your cash allows. Bank jobs and fences fund them: by the time you have finished the robbery side of the 100% checklist, you will have the money. The trophy pops when the last garage is yours.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, pick a vehicle you own or have found, and register it — repeat with ten different vehicles. Any ten count, so use the cars already in your garages first, then grab a few more off the street. The trophy pops on the tenth registration.
